correctness.rationale: The published iff run-start Zeckendorf regular expression has a unique decomposition into three nonnegative repetition parameters A,b,c and four middle/final choices. For t=A+b+c the four word lengths are 2t+6, 2t+7, 2t+7, 2t+8, each occurring binom(t+2,2) times. Hockey-stick summation proves R_L and L^3/12 leading term. For F_{L+1}<=N<F_{L+2}, each one-run start below F_{L+1} has a preceding nonempty zero-run and each zero-run is at most 13 positions, hence R_{L-1}<=Z(N)<=13(R_L+1). Fibonacci exponential growth gives Theta((log N)^3). Independent canonical-Zeckendorf counting for L=6..16 and direct 700-symbol cube ending check match; infinite claim relies on analytic bijection and published run lemmas.
residual_risks: Published regex and zero-run classifications are imported, not reproved from morphism; relies on correct interpretation of canonical Zeckendorf representations.
